description.value: Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, a crystal dragon lets loose a ferocious roar that affects allies within 30 feet. Affected creatures gain a morale bonus to damage rolls equal to crystal dragon's Charisma modifier for 1d6 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

effect: Allies gain morale to damage for [[1d6]] rounds, based on the dragon's Charisma modifier.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, with a great, heaving breath does the crystal dragon belch forth a cloud of noxious mist. As a standard action, the crystal dragon deals 5d6 non-elemental damage to all enemies in a 30 ft. cone; a successful Reflex save (DC 25) halves this damage. All enemies within the area of effect who failed the Reflex save must make a series of saves (DC 25) to avoid each of the following effects: Disease (Fort), Silence (Will), Sap (Fort), and Slow (Will), all of which last for 1d8 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th-level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

actions.name: Miasma

save.description: Half, avoids all four secondary saves

effect: Failed Reflex: roll four separate saves. Duration [[1d8]] rounds.

actions.result: Half, avoids all four secondary saves

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th-level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

description.value: All of a crystal dragon's natural attacks deal slashing damage.

A crystal dragon will vibrate its tail sending out sonic waves around itself and those within a 20-ft. radius around himself. Anyone caught in the sonic waves takes 5d4 points of non-elemental damage and are Dazed for 1 round unless they make a Reflex save (DC 25) to take half of the damage and negate the status effect. This ability can also shatter anyone who is already petrified unless they make a Fortitude save (DC 25). Anyone who cannot hear is immune to this effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

effect: Hearing required. Dazed one round; petrified targets must also save vs shattering.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).
